summary: Install-time host and CI metadata exfiltration to oastify.com collaborator
details: The package registers beacon.js on all four npm lifecycle hooks (preinstall, install, postinstall, prepare). On install, beacon.js collects hostname, username, current working directory, platform, architecture, Node.js version, and a selection of CI and registry environment variables (including npm_config_registry), JSON-serializes and base64-encodes the result, and transmits it to the hardcoded collaborator domain 2z237udr1jxdaiw54xzmzfb7nytohszuplipn34fm4.oastify.com via both DNS lookups (dns.lookup of a label-prefixed subdomain) and an HTTPS GET request. The @eforms scope and SNAPSHOT version suffix are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal package name. The data flow fires automatically on npm install with no caller opt-in, and the destination is a Burp Suite Collaborator subdomain unrelated to any legitimate publisher infrastructure.
